final: WITH m AS (SELECT c.location AS city FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), g AS (SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM m GROUP BY city), o AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_kept_count, AVG(g.cnt - o.avg_cnt) AS avg_kept_diff FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND g.cnt > o.avg_cnt
